requirements.title: ATAN argument restrictions depend on whether Y appears
requirements.definition: Y shall be real. If Y appears, X shall be real with the same kind type parameter as Y and X shall be nonzero when Y is zero. If Y does not appear, X shall be real or complex.

pending.atan-y-real: Use real Y values in positive controls; nonreal Y probes remain source-control only because this unnumbered restriction carries no required diagnostic.
pending.atan-two-argument-x-real-same-kind: Use same-kind real X and Y controls; kind-mismatch probes remain source-control only.
pending.atan-two-argument-zero-zero-excluded: Use pairs (Y=0,X=1) and (Y=1,X=0) as conforming boundary controls; the (0,0) probe is nonconforming and has no portable diagnostic oracle here.
pending.atan-one-argument-x-real-or-complex: Use one-argument real and complex X controls and assert only same-characteristics and range properties, not exact approximations.

requirements.title: One-argument ATAN real part is radians in the interval minus pi over two through pi over two
requirements.definition: If Y does not appear, the real result or real part of ATAN(X) is expressed in radians and lies in the range -pi/2 through pi/2.

pending.atan-one-argument-real-part-radians: Use real and complex one-argument X controls and assert only the registered radian range property for the real result or REAL(result).
pending.atan-one-argument-real-part-range: Initialize observed real components to out-of-range sentinels, call ATAN on representative real and complex inputs, and assert the real value lies in the required closed interval using a registered pi/range helper.

Class paragraph classifies ATAN as elemental.
